mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS over 20-day returns remains below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window or average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS declines is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% signals tight labor market conditions that may trigger wage inflation and premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return when UNRATE < 5.0% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occurs in fewer than 30% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (p > 0.05) in regression of 20-day returns or negative return pattern fails in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0% of 2017 base signals manufacturing slowdown that triggers recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day return during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO < 95.0 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or pattern holds in <35% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or signal occurs in <25% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 over 60-day returns is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window or average 60-day return when GDPC1 rises is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 95.0% of 2017 base signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return when INDPRO < 95.0 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or pattern holds in <30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals aggressive monetary tightening in a tight labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE is not significant (p > 0.05) in regression of 5-day returns or negative return pattern fails in >45% of triggered instances.
